content.title: Rigetti Computing Stock Is Downgraded. Why This Analyst Prefers D-Wave Quantum and IonQ.
content.summary: Triple-digit gains in the stock of  Rigetti Computing  one of the hottest names in quantum computing, are giving one analyst pause.  B. Riley Securities analyst Craig Ellis downgraded Rigetti to Neutral from Buy and raised his price target on the stock to $42 from $35 in a note Monday.  Barron’s reported in August that Rigetti had been selected for a $5.8 million Air Force contract, which the company announced a month later along with two purchase orders for a combined $5.7 million on Sept. 30.
